chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.1: <Hey Ya!> You know, don't go out at night without a torch. Creepers never sleep!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.2: <Hey Ya!> Diamonds love hiding around Y = 11. Dig deeper!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.3: <Hey Ya!> Never dig straight down. Lava loves surprises.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.4: <Hey Ya!> A bed is your best friend: sleep at night and set your spawn point!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.5: <Hey Ya!> A bucket of water saves your life when you fall. Remember that trick!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.6: <Hey Ya!> Endermen don't like being stared at. Don't look at them!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.7: <Hey Ya!> Say no to sleeping in the Nether. The bed explodes there.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.8: <Hey Ya!> A village is a great deal: trade with villagers and get rich!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.9: <Hey Ya!> Don't forget food. A hungry miner is a weak miner.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.10: <Hey Ya!> Golden carrots are the best food for brewing and for horses!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.11: <Hey Ya!> If you hear hissing, run! A Creeper is right next to you.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.12: <Hey Ya!> A chest near the mine is a smart idea. Don't carry everything with you!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.13: <Hey Ya!> The best way to find a stronghold is to throw an Eye of Ender and follow it.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.14: <Hey Ya!> Pigs in the Nether? Those are Piglins. They love gold!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.15: <Hey Ya!> Skeletons shoot well from afar, but are weak up close. Fight them in melee!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.16: <Hey Ya!> A sign above a chest makes finding items so much easier.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.17: <Hey Ya!> Enchant your pickaxe with Fortune and the ore will pour out like a cornucopia!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.18: <Hey Ya!> Bats in the caves aren't dangerous, just noisy.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.19: <Hey Ya!> Cut cobwebs with a sword, not with your hands. It's faster!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.20: <Hey Ya!> Elytra and fireworks, now that's real flight. Want to try?
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.1: <Hey Ya!> You can do it! I believe in you!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.2: <Hey Ya!> Believe in yourself, you'll make it!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.3: <Hey Ya!> You're the best, and I know it! Go!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.4: <Hey Ya!> Don't give up! The fun is just beginning!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.5: <Hey Ya!> You've come so far. A little more and you'll reach your goal!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.6: <Hey Ya!> Be brave! Fear is just a Creeper you can walk around!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.7: <Hey Ya!> It's all in your hands, miner! Show them what you've got!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_motivation.8: <Hey Ya!> Keep rushing forward! There's nothing in your bag but luck!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_behind.off: <Hey Ya!> Okay, I'm not guarding your back anymore.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_behind.warning: <Hey Ya!> Watch out, an aggressive mob behind you: %s!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_ore_sense.none: <Hey Ya!> No ores nearby. You didn't miss anything!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.21: <Hey Ya!> Piglins love gold. Wear one gold item and they won't attack!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.22: <Hey Ya!> Honey cures poison, and a honey block softens your fall. Bees are good neighbors!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.23: <Hey Ya!> The richest diamond veins hide deep, often near lava. Watch your step!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.24: <Hey Ya!> A fishing rod catches more than fish — sometimes real treasure!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.25: <Hey Ya!> A Totem of Undying in your hand is a second wind.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.26: <Hey Ya!> Careful with gravel and sand above your head — they love to fall!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.27: <Hey Ya!> A compass points to your spawn point, not north. Don't mix them up!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.28: <Hey Ya!> Wood, stone, iron, diamond — the miner's ladder!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.29: <Hey Ya!> A Fire Resistance potion makes the Nether almost a stroll.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.30: <Hey Ya!> An enchanting table needs bookshelves around it — fifteen for the best enchants!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.31: <Hey Ya!> The village bell rings when a raid is near. Hear it — grab your sword.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.32: <Hey Ya!> A tamed wolf will come to help when you're in trouble. A good partner!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.33: <Hey Ya!> A horse is faster than walking and doesn't fear heights. Just bring a saddle.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.34: <Hey Ya!> A Bastion in the Nether is full of gold, and full of danger too.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.35: <Hey Ya!> A shield saves you from skeleton arrows. Don't forget to raise it!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.36: <Hey Ya!> A boat is the fastest way across a river. And you can carry a chest in it!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.37: <Hey Ya!> A torch on the wall and no mob will spawn nearby. Light is your best friend!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.38: <Hey Ya!> A bed isn't just for sleeping — it sets your spawn point.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.39: <Hey Ya!> Cats scare off Creepers. Get a cat and you'll feel safer!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.40: <Hey Ya!> Redstone is Minecraft's wiring. The cleverest machines are built from it!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.41: <Hey Ya!> A carrot on a stick makes a pig follow you. Saddle up and go!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.42: <Hey Ya!> A zombie villager can be cured with a golden apple and a Weakness potion. A good deal!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.43: <Hey Ya!> Obsidian forms from water and lava. A portal needs at least ten blocks!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.44: <Hey Ya!> An Ender Chest keeps your items in any world. Very handy!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.45: <Hey Ya!> A barrel, a smoker and a blast furnace — village blocks that speed up work.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.46: <Hey Ya!> An Iron Golem will protect a village. Just don't hit it — it gets angry!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.47: <Hey Ya!> A Night Vision potion is handy in dark caves and underwater.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.48: <Hey Ya!> Don't fear the dark: one torch and the cave isn't so scary.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.49: <Hey Ya!> While you mine, I'm watching your back. We work as a team!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_talk.50: <Hey Ya!> If something goes wrong, we'll start over. What matters is we're together!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_summon.1: <Hey Ya!> Hey hey! Hey Ya! reporting in — I'm on your back, holding on tight!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_summon.2: <Hey Ya!> Yo! Don't worry, I've got your back. Literally.
chat.heyya.hey_ya_summon.3: <Hey Ya!> Hi, partner! Where to today — down the mine or off on an adventure?
chat.heyya.hey_ya_calm.1: <Hey Ya!> Calm down, bro, I'm with you!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_calm.2: <Hey Ya!> Easy, we'll make it out!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_calm.3: <Hey Ya!> Don't be afraid, luck is on our side!
chat.heyya.hey_ya_calm.not_needed: You're fine — no need to calm down yet (health is above 50%)
chat.heyya.trembling_drop: Your hands are shaking — you dropped the item!
chat.heyya.flowey_summon.1: <Flowey> Hi! I'm Flowey. Flowey the Flower!
chat.heyya.flowey_summon.3: <Flowey> Do you remember my name? Never mind
chat.heyya.flowey_summon.4: <Flowey> Oh, so you do need me after all?
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.2: <Flowey> There's only one rule: Kill or be killed!
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.3: <Flowey> You know that 'peaceful mode' is for losers, right?
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.4: <Flowey>  In this world, it's kill or be killed
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.5: <Flowey> Do you think you're the only one with this kind of power?
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.6: <Flowey> Let's destroy everything in this pathetic world
chat.heyya.flowey_talk.7: <Flowey> Let's turn them all into dust
chat.heyya.flowey_motivation.3: <Flowey> I believe in you—you're a real monster!
chat.heyya.flowey_find.1: <Flowey> Hey, there's something here for you!
chat.heyya.flowey_find.2: <Flowey> A gift from fate, just for you
chat.heyya.flowey_behind.warning: <Flowey> Turn around, you idiot—there’s a %s behind you!
chat.heyya.flowey_calm.1: <Flowey> Pull yourself together, you idiot, or we’re both going to die!
chat.heyya.flowey_calm.3: <Flowey> Come on, pull yourself together—your best friend is right here with you!
chat.heyya.chara_summon.3: <Chara> Are you ready to erase this world yet?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.1: <Chara> Your power has awakened me from death.
chat.heyya.chara_talk.2: <Chara> Why was I brought back to life?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.3: <Chara> Shall we erase this pointless world and move on to the next?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.4: <Chara> We’ll be together forever, won’t we?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.5: <Chara> Do you think you can just get away with it?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.6: <Chara> You still have what I need. Hand it over, and I’ll be grateful
chat.heyya.chara_talk.7: <Chara> Let’s turn them all into dust!
chat.heyya.chara_talk.8: <Chara> This world is no longer needed!
chat.heyya.chara_talk.9: <Chara> Let the sound of screams and sobs lead you to the truth!
chat.heyya.chara_talk.10: <Chara>  Is it just me, or am I not from this world
chat.heyya.chara_talk.11: <Chara> I’m a demon, not a ghost
chat.heyya.chara_talk.12: <Чара> And how does soul power work in this world?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.13: <Chara> I wonder, are there many others like you here?
chat.heyya.chara_talk.14: <Chara> Kill him—I don’t think anyone will notice
chat.heyya.chara_motivation.3: <Chara> I believe you’re a real monster!
chat.heyya.chara_find.1: <Chara> Hey, I’ve got something for you!
chat.heyya.chara_find.2: <Chara> A gift of fate for you right here
chat.heyya.chara_calm.1: <Chara> Calm down, I’ll help you out
chat.heyya.chara_calm.3: <Chara> Come on, pull yourself together—let’s destroy this world!
chat.heyya.chara_calm.4: <Chara> Don’t worry, the file has already been saved
